title: Schauberger taken by SS to secret work

tellings.quote: In 1941, an SS officer approached Schauberger in Austria, which prompted a period of complete silence in his life.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1941 an officer of the SS, the Nazi regime's elite force, approached an Austrian man named Viktor Schauberger, and that a period of complete silence in Schauberger's life followed. Michels points to a letter Schauberger wrote to his son, and the story suggests he was taken to do secret work for the Nazis in Austria and Czechoslovakia.
